metric_definitions.settling_time_s: time after an event until |P - P_final| <= 0.02 P_final for the rest of the 60 s window (sampled on a log grid; upper bound at sampling resolution); null = NOT settled -> TRANSIENT_NOT_SETTLED_WITHIN_WINDOW
metric_definitions.flow_recovery_s: same rule on the delivered total flow mdot_H1
metric_definitions.overshoot_frac: setpoint events: max(0, max sign(dP)(P - P_final)) / |P_final - P_previous|
metric_definitions.peak_deviation_frac: disturbance events (feed path, supply): max |P - r| / r
metric_definitions.ripple_pp_frac_mdot: orbit check: (max - min) / mean of the delivered flow over one orbit at each state
metric_definitions.ripple_transfer_shaft: open-loop plenum attenuation 1/sqrt(1 + (2 pi f tau_s)^2) at the compressor shaft frequency (the lowest possible ripple frequency), least-attenuated species: an upper bound on the fraction of a compressor flow ripple that reaches the plenum pressure
metric_definitions.valve_travel: sum |du| over the event sequence (fraction of full stroke): controller effort
metric_definitions.min_max_over_scenario: P, mdot, x_O min / max over the event sequence (summary) and over the orbit at every F1 state (orbit check rows)
metric_definitions.saturation: valve command outside [0, 1] at the end of an event, or u > 1 needed at any orbit phase -> VALVE_SATURATED_SETPOINT_NOT_MAINTAINED
